decisions.evidence: The imported definition supplies period-one action-angle naming, fibres and the symplectic-form identity; no smooth quotient atlas is inferred from it. The consumer explicitly fixes quotient topology, short-box lift charts, integer-translation transition maps, Hausdorffness, second countability, local diffeomorphism q_n, invariant angle differentials and product charts. Quotient openness follows from integer saturation; side lengths less than one give injectivity; locally fixed integer transition vectors are smooth and preserve lift differentials. The imported torus definition supplies Hausdorffness and countable bases for the finite product. Consequently the target and all differential symbols in this exact use have independently supplied meaning. The radian corollary imports the explicit atlas and proves [x]->[2pi x] with inverse and scaled differentials in those lift charts. This closes the exact owned use, without repairing or accepting the missing atlas in the imported original.
